;; D30: a full source match whose mandatory side effect fails is not a
;; successful simple-rule application. Both runtimes continue to the next
;; candidate; the first A- candidate fails `gate`, the later B- succeeds.

GOAL
Z

A-B-

BIND x move y move_last

CMD move
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  1- 1E gate!

CMD gate
 BE BE

CMD move_last
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  1- 1E gate_a! [lastmatch]

CMD gate_a
 AE AE
